headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises IFC on $150 million financing to SBI GIFT City
sum: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co acted as legal counsel to International Finance Corporation in connection with an unsecured USD-denominated term loan facility of up to $150 million availed by State Bank of India's GIFT City Branch. The…
detail: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co acted as legal counsel to International Finance Corporation in connection with an unsecured USD-denominated term loan facility of up to $150 million availed by State Bank of India's GIFT City Branch. The transaction was led by Shubhangi Garg (Partner), and included Yashika Jain (Principal Associate) and Aryan Gupta (Associate). The financing is aimed at expanding access to credit for micro-entrepreneurs through the Self-Help Group (SHG) model, with at least 90% of the lending earmarked for women micro-entrepreneurs, including women engaged in agriculture and allied activities.
